title: AWS Secrets Manager: bulk fetch needs `secretsmanager:BatchGetSecretValue`

detection.reason: the IAM policy of the role a store assumes is not collected

quote: Permission update for AWS provider adding BulkFetch when getting multiple secrets ( significant API reduce but comes with adding a permission for bulk endpoint )
remediation: Add `secretsmanager:BatchGetSecretValue` to the IAM policy of every role the AWS Secrets Manager stores named assume; `dataFrom.find` lookups call BatchGetSecretValue with no fallback and fail without it.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("aws")) | select(.spec.provider.aws.service == "SecretsManager") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) role=\(.spec.provider.aws.role // "-")"'  # each row is an AWS Secrets Manager store; check its role for BatchGetSecretValue

title: GCP Secret Manager: PushSecret metadata must use the standardized `PushSecretMetadata` format

detection.reason: the store a PushSecret pushes to is a reference; the projection carries each data entry's metadata FORMAT, not the provider behind its store

quote: We standardized the GCP Secrets Manager Metadata structure for PushSecrets ( be aware that existing manifests will stop working until updated to the standardized version ) for more info see https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4210
remediation: For each PushSecret named whose store is GCP Secret Manager, wrap `spec.data[].metadata` as `apiVersion: kubernetes.external-secrets.io/v1alpha1`, `kind: PushSecretMetadata`, `spec: {annotations, labels, mergePolicy, cmekKeyName}`; the old bare `{annotations, labels}` form stops pushing.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pushsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterpushsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(any((.spec.data // .spec.pushSecretSpec.data // [])[]; .metadata != null and .metadata.kind != "PushSecretMetadata")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) stores=\([(.spec.secretStoreRefs // .spec.pushSecretSpec.secretStoreRefs // [])[].name] | join(","))"'  # each row pushes metadata in the old format

title: ClusterGenerator: `ecrRAuthorizationTokenSpec` json key renamed to `ecrAuthorizationTokenSpec`
quote: fixed a typo for a generator in the json tag where before it was `ecrRAuthorizationTokenSpec` with an extra R
remediation: Rename `spec.generator.ecrRAuthorizationTokenSpec` to `ecrAuthorizationTokenSpec` in every ClusterGenerator that wraps an ECR token generator; the old key is dropped by the new CRD.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clustergenerators.generators.external-secrets.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.generator | has("ecrRAuthorizationTokenSpec")) | .metadata.name'  # each name still uses the misspelled key
